hotfixes.name: vold-easyroms-write
hotfixes.title: Saving to the games card
hotfixes.description: let apps write saves to the games SD card under the default sdcardfs storage layer

hotfixes.name: soysauce-speaker
hotfixes.title: Soy Sauce speaker
hotfixes.description: Internal speaker fix for Soy Sauce V04 clones. Plays through the speaker and headphones together (like dArkOSRE), so the speaker works again. The headphone jack switch still mutes the speaker when you plug headphones in.

hotfixes.name: no-screen-pinning
hotfixes.title: Stop screen pinning
hotfixes.description: Removes screen pinning. A stray button press could pin an app and leave you stuck on one screen; this stops that.

hotfixes.name: usb-kbm-preset
hotfixes.title: USB keyboard & mouse
hotfixes.description: Adds a Keyboard & mouse USB preset that needs no image
